title: Spiked Blackberry-Marjoram Limeade
description: You can make the boozy fruit puree up to two days in advance. Top with seltzer and garnish with blackberries, lime wedges, and marjoram leaves before serving. Recipe courtesy of Erin French, chef and owner of Lost Kitchen in Freedom, ME.
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh lime juice (from 2 limes), plus lime wedges for serving
1/2 teaspoon fresh marjoram leaves, plus more for serving
16 ounces seltzer or club soda, chilled
1/2 cup fresh lemon juice (from 2 to 3 lemons), plus lemon rounds, for serving
16 ounces seltzer or club soda, chilled
directions: Puree blackberries, lime juice, vodka, sugar, and marjoram in a blender. Strain through a fine-mesh sieve, pressing on solids with a flexible spatula; discard solids. Puree can be made ahead and refrigerated in an airtight container up to 2 days.
Divide puree among 8 ice-filled glasses. Fill with seltzer; stir. Serve, garnished with blackberries, lime wedges, and marjoram.
Divide cordial, lemon juice, and vodka among 8 ice-filled glasses. Top with seltzer; stir. Serve, garnished with lemon rounds.
Bring 2 cups sugar and 2 cups water to a boil, stirring, until sugar is dissolved, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat; let cool completely.

Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine ½ cup lemon juice, 6 lemon zest strips (2 lemons), and 12 elderflowers heads, stems removed (or 1/4 cup dried elderflower heads). Pour syrup over flower mixture; stir to combine. Cover and refrigerate 1 day. Strain cordial through a fine-mesh sieve; discard flowers. Cordial can be refrigerated in an airtight container up to 1 month.
